errors.hotkeys_unavailable: Keys aren't active yet — Accessibility access needed
errors.not_assignable: Use a right-side modifier (⌥ ⌘ ⌃ ⇧), Fn, Caps Lock or an F-key
errors.taken: This key is already used for {mode}
general.record_mode_hint: Hold — speak while the key is down. Toggle — press once to start, again to stop.
general.insert_method_hint: “Type” is for apps that don't accept paste.
general.speech_language_hint: A hint for recognition. “Auto” detects the language.
general.cleanup_hint: Removes “um”, “uh” and repeats, adds punctuation. Never changes the meaning.
hotkeys.title: Keys
hotkeys.subtitle: Hold a key and speak. Release it and the text appears at the cursor.
hotkeys.dictation_hint: Text in the language you speak
hotkeys.translate_hint: English text in the chosen style
translate.title: Translation
translate.subtitle: Speak any language — English text is inserted.
translate.example_source: Hola, ¿me puedes mandar el informe antes del viernes? ¡Gracias!
translate.example_business: Hi, could you please send me the report by Friday? Thank you.
translate.example_casual: Hey, can you send me the report by Friday? Thanks!
provider.title: Provider
provider.subtitle: Speech is recognised in the chosen service's cloud with your own key. There are no Utter servers.
provider.openai_caption: Pay as you go — not a ChatGPT subscription
history.title: History
history.subtitle: The last 50 recordings. Stored only on this Mac.
history.empty: Your dictations and translations will appear here
about.title: About
about.tagline: Press a key, speak, and the text appears.
about.diagnostics_hint: Version, system, settings without keys and recent log lines — for a bug report.
onboarding.welcome_body: Hold a key, say a phrase and let go. The text — or its English translation — appears at your cursor.
onboarding.demo_source: Hola, ¿me puedes mandar el informe antes del viernes?
onboarding.demo_result: Hi, could you send me the report by Friday?
onboarding.mic_body: Utter listens only while the key is held. Audio goes straight to the service you choose.
onboarding.mic_denied: Access was denied. Turn on Utter in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
onboarding.ax_body: Needed to catch the hotkey in any app and to insert text. Open the settings and turn on the switch next to Utter.
onboarding.ax_waiting: Waiting for you to turn it on…
onboarding.provider_body: Google Gemini is free — sign in with Google. Create a key, paste it here and press “Check”.
onboarding.key_body: Press the key you want to use. Right ⌥ Option works best — it's already set.
onboarding.trial_body: Hold {key} and say something. The result appears here.
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Without these Utter can't record or insert text.
